summary.headline: Ninth House and Faith
summary.text: Discussion of the ninth house in natal astrology: mutable or fixed signs indicate instability or constancy in faith, law, counsel, and work, while benefic placements favor wisdom and sound judgment. Mercury and the Moon with the Part of Faith signify learning and interpretation, Jupiter adds truthfulness and esteem, and the North Node is considered in the third or ninth house.
